summary_zh: 2026-08-11 全球活跃热带系统 10 个。下方为各系统位置、强度、最近航线与航运影响,供避台航线规划。
summary_en: On 2026-08-11, 10 active tropical system(s) are tracked. Position, intensity, the nearest shipping route and impact for each are summarized below for voyage avoidance.
